war_summary: War 139 is on day 86 of conquest with no winner declared; victory requires 32 towns (30 short). The front is split between Colonial-held and Warden-held regions with several contested zones. Pressure is heavily concentrated in ClahstraHex, CallahansPassageHex, DeadLandsHex, SpeakingWoodsHex, StlicanShelfHex, OarbreakerHex, and MooringCountyHex, where casualty rates are high and recent capture events are frequent. Uncertainty is greatest in split-ownership regions—especially OarbreakerHex (5/4 Warden), OnyxHex (3/3), GodcroftsHex (5/4 Warden), CallahansPassageHex (8/2 Warden), and MooringCountyHex (2/10 Warden)—where accelerating enlistments and recent base-flip events suggest ownership could shift within 24 hours. Many other regions show zero recent events and stable ownership, reducing near-term strategic risk there.
